comment: SSOT for the review-finding severity model. `gating` lists the severities whose findings escalate the posted review to REQUEST_CHANGES, which is what holds the merge until the author addresses or the reviewer clears them; `icons` maps every severity to the emoji its posted finding leads with. Consumers: post-pr-review.mjs (renders findings, decides the review event). Editing this file changes review behavior with no code change.
